about: The Workbench icons of the TunnelTanks drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/tunneltanks.png is the game's own blue tank (TANK_SPRITE[1] in src/tanksprites.c, TunnelTanks, GPL-3.0) in a tunnel through its dirt colours, 8 x 8 scaled to 64 x 64. TunnelTanks-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, TunnelTanks.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt.
